# Styr.ing

> Styr.ing is a Norwegian governance SaaS concept with demo surfaces for board work, deadline tracking and internal-control activities. Production scope and functionality are confirmed before activation.

## About

Founded in 2026, Styr.ing builds practical governance systems for Norwegian businesses that need to consolidate goals, responsibilities, deviations, routines, and improvements in one clear interface without drowning in documents.

Built to help Norwegian businesses structure board work, deadlines, controls and documentation. Customers remain responsible for determining and meeting the legal requirements that apply to them.

## Who It's For

- Norwegian limited companies (AS) with active boards
- SMBs needing structured board governance
- Companies preparing for audits, board meetings, and regulatory filings
- Organizations wanting to move board work from email attachments to a centralized platform

## How It Works

1. Visitors may explore the public board, deadline and internal-control concept pages without creating an account
2. The public Styr.ing site does not provide a separate activation, purchase or lead-capture flow
3. Styr.ing is SaaS-only; production activation and billing require an approved subscription workflow
4. Production scope, onboarding and commercial terms require a documented customer agreement

## Key Features

- Digital Board Books: Demo workflow for collecting board documents and meeting material
- Deadline Calendar: A workspace for deadlines and responsibilities the customer identifies; reminder behavior depends on the agreed setup
- Internal Control Framework: Document controls, deviations, and risk assessments relevant to internal-control work
- AI-Assisted Governance: When enabled, AI can draft material that users must review and approve
- Goal & Performance Management: Demo workflow for goals and follow-up
- Deviation Registration: Demo workflow for registering deviations and follow-up

## Offer Status

- No separate active Styr.ing offer or public price
- No self-service account creation, checkout, subscription, or billing on the public site
- Styr.ing is SaaS-only; no public checkout or self-service activation is enabled on the preview
- Production scope, onboarding, functionality, pricing, and processing terms require documented customer agreement

## Tech Stack

- Astro 4 (static site generation)
- Cloudflare Pages hosting
- No runtime data service is connected to the public static demo
- TypeScript
- HTML5 semantic markup
- JSON-LD structured data
